companyDescription: AI Drug Discovery Platform · OS for Biology · Sanofi/Roche/Genentech partnerships · 7 wholly-owned programs · $665M cash runway to 2028
priceNote: Jun 22 close. Down 67%+ from ATH. Q1 2026 revenue missed badly ($6.47M vs $16.28M est) — stock crushed. Cash $665M intact (runway to early 2028). JP Morgan $10 Buy = +215%. 5 pipeline inflection points expected next 12–18 months.
summary: RXRX at $3.18 is a binary AI drug discovery platform bet. Built the 'OS for Biology' — mapping biology at scale using robotics + ML. Partners: Sanofi, Roche, Genentech. Cash $665M (runway 2028). Revenue missed Q1 ($6.47M vs $16M est) but cumulative partner inflows >$500M. 5 programs hit inflection in next 12–18 months. JP Morgan $10 Buy (+215%). Hold consensus (8 analysts) — pure contrarian moonshot.

catalysts.name: Pipeline Inflection Points — 5 Programs
catalysts.description: Management guided 5 wholly-owned programs to reach defined inflection points within 12–18 months from May 2026 (i.e., by Nov 2026 – Nov 2027). Any Phase 2 positive readout or major partnership deal = 100%+ re-rate in a single day.

catalysts.name: Sanofi / Roche / Genentech Milestones
catalysts.description: Achieved 5th Sanofi milestone (Q1 2026, $4M) for oncology lead series. Cumulative partner inflows >$500M, 10+ milestones delivered. Next milestones from Sanofi/Roche/Genentech programs coming H2 2026. Each milestone announcement = stock catalyst.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings + Pipeline Data
catalysts.description: Q1 revenue miss ($6.47M vs $16.28M) reset the bar low. Q2 earnings ~Aug 7 — any pipeline data positive read or milestone payment could drive recovery. Cash position update will reaffirm or undermine 2028 runway thesis.

risks: Q1 2026 revenue $6.47M missed $16.28M estimate by 60% — execution concern with milestone timing

comparableCases.event: Exact Sciences — Cologuard platform FDA approval + CMS reimbursement
comparableCases.note: EXAS went from $4 to $20 (+400%) in 18 months post-FDA approval of Cologuard. AI-for-diagnostics platform thesis proved in the market. RXRX's 'OS for Biology' is analogous — waiting for first clinical validation. If it comes, multi-year run follows.

comparableCases.event: CRISPR Therapeutics — first positive gene editing clinical data
comparableCases.note: CRSP went from $30 to $90 (+200%) in 3 months when first positive gene editing data published. RXRX's first positive AI-discovered drug clinical data could trigger similar 'platform validation' re-rate. Cautionary: CRSP also fell 70% afterward on commercial uncertainty.

comparableCases.event: Twist Bioscience — synthetic biology scale validation + partnership wave
comparableCases.note: TWST $20 → $88 (+340%) on synthetic biology platform thesis in early 2021. AI + biology platform stocks go through massive re-rates on narrative validation before revenue proves it. RXRX is at the same 'pre-validation' stage. Cautionary: TWST later fell 90% as revenue growth disappointed.
